title: After the Oka Sho: A Blossoming Smile

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Pant… pant…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: …Phew.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (My arms and legs feel so heavy… and my heart's still racing. But… I'm okay.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (I have to go to where Trainer's waiting for me!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm overwhelmed. Even though her opponents were older, she breezed past them with ease. Watching her running so earnestly and purposefully…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Has filled me with courage and confidence.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Trainer… Um…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
choice_data_list: Thank you for giving me courage.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I've always felt this way, but I'm so glad you're my trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Of all the times we could have met, I'm so glad it was now!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Do you remember what happened after the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: …I'll tell you after the Oka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I couldn't help but think things like, "Why does it have to be now?"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: "I wish I'd become race-ready after I'd grown bigger. Trainer's been working so hard, but look at me." That's the kind of stuff I was worrying about.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I've had similar thoughts before too. "If only I had met her when I had more experience as a trainer…"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Everyone says that it's great that I was able to skip grades. But now, I'm at a disadvantage. Things are so much harder for me.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: But I'm sure… it had to be now.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: …Because of you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: It's because I skipped grades and entered Tracen early that I could meet you—my kind, hard-working trainer who's always worrying about me.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Things aren't easy for you either, but you still do everything you can for me…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: When you're with me, I feel like… I can keep pushing myself to work harder.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I think the reason I became race-ready before the others my age…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: …was so I could meet you.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: That's why all of the cheers I received today are yours.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: They're proof of how wonderful a trainer you are!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes. Trainer, you're incredible.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I mean, just look at how far you've brought me, despite how small I am!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm going to keep working even harder from now on!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thank you for devoting so much of yourself to helping me. I appreciate everything you've done!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nishino Flower is always like this. It was a race she could only ever run once in her life, and she ran it for me.
choice_data_list: Then the reason you decided to run in a G1 race…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes. I thought it would help you if I won something big.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: And once I won, everyone would learn what a wonderful trainer you are. ♪
choice_data_list: Why are you willing to go so far for me?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To put it bluntly, I only became her trainer by chance. Why would she care so much about someone she was randomly assigned to?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Why?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Because you do your best for me. You believe in me, and you really care.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Is it weird to want the best for the person who's always stayed by my side and treated me so kindly?
choice_data_list: No, not at all! Thank you, Flower!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: You don't need to thank me. I'm just doing what I want to do.
choice_data_list: I'm so glad that we met each other now! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm glad too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her kindness runs far deeper than I had imagined. Though I'm grateful for her, I've also been made painfully aware of my own inexperience.
choice_data_list: (I want to become a trainer who can support her.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Now, more than ever, I'm determined to become a better trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Trainer. I'd like to stick to this path we're on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Since the Oka Sho is over, continuing this path means our next goal will be the second race of the Triple Tiara—the Japanese Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Right now, I feel like my legs can take me anywhere!
choice_data_list: All right! Then let's take on the Japanese Oaks!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes, let's!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: All right! I'm going to get changed!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But as I watch Nishino Flower walk away, I can't help but feel a small seed of anxiety growing inside of me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Of all the races she's run so far, this will be her first medium-distance race. Will she be able to perform her best?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Either way, if she's looking toward the future, then there's nothing to do but forge on ahead together.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Hello, little gerberas. You're all blooming so beautifully. ♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm going to keep doing my best, so that you can have plenty of friends blooming alongside you…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: And that means winning the Japanese Oaks!
